description: This file defines a serializer and deserializer for the SiloAddress class, used for encoding and decoding SiloAddress instances within the Orleans framework serialization system.

classes.name: SiloAddressCodec
classes.description: Serializer and deserializer for SiloAddress instances, implementing IFieldCodec for custom serialization within Orleans.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a SiloAddress object onto the writer, handling null values and writing individual address components.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a SiloAddress object from the reader, reconstructing the object from its serialized fields.
